भूरि multus, praesertim in initio compp. e. c. भूरितेजस् magnum
splendorem, magnam vim habens.

.;
v. sq. (Huc traxerim gr. μῡϱίος, mutato भ् in nasalem
ejusdem organi; huc etiam trahi possent hib. mor et lat.
mul-tus, nisi pertinent ad पुरु q. v.)

भूरिदक्षिण (BAH. e भूरि et दक्षिणा q. v.) multa dona sacrificalia
habens vel praebens.

भूर्ज m. nomen arboris (Wils. «The Bhôj or Bhôjpatr,
a tree growing in the snowy mountains, and called by
travellers a kind of birch; the bark is used for writing
on»).
